Ja, imava dva otroka. Še mlada sta. is correct and natural. The dual imava fits two speakers and dva otroka is the right dual after dva. Mlada is the masculine dual, which agrees with otrok and is also used for a mixed pair. Fronting še mlada before the clitic sta is normal second-position order, a natural variant of Sta še mlada. SSKJ uses še mlad for people's age (njeni starši so še mladi). A native might more often say še majhna sta about small children, but mlada would not stand out. The English matches.
